7 Cards Least Game Online – Official Guide & Portal

An indie tactical card game where the lowest hand score wins. Learn deck setup, zero-point table Jokers, Match & Skip mechanics, and tournament survival.

7 Cards Least is an indie card shedding game built around calculated risk, card deduction, and timing. Each player is dealt 7 cards from a standard deck (or two decks for tables with 6 to 8 players). Unlike traditional rummy where you keep cards to meld long sequences, your entire goal here is hand reduction: stripping out heavy point cards while maneuvering into a sub-10 point hand to declare Least.

🎴 Deck Setup & The Table Joker Wildcard

A game uses a standard 52-card deck (single deck for 2 to 5 players; two shuffled decks for 6 to 8 players) with no physical jokers. At the beginning of each round, 1 card is flipped face-up in the center to establish the zero-point Joker rank. Any card matching this rank in any player's hand scores 0 points! For example, if a 7 is flipped, all four 7s (7♠, 7♥, 7♦, 7♣) count as 0 points. A second card is flipped face-up to begin the Discard Pile, and 7 cards are dealt to each player.

📋 Card Point Values

Hand scores are calculated by summing the point values of all remaining cards:

  • Ace (A): 1 Point (the lowest standard card).
  • Number Cards (2 to 10): Face Value (2–10 points based on rank).
  • Face Cards (Jack, Queen, King): 10 Points each (high liability cards to discard early).
  • Table Joker Rank: 0 Points (established by the round setup flip).
  • Least Calling Window: Total hand score must be 10 points or less to call Least.
  • False Call Penalty: An 80-point penalty is assessed if an opponent holds an equal or lower score.

🕹️ Turn Progression & Actions

Turns proceed clockwise around the table. Each turn involves two distinct phases:

  1. Phase 1 – Discarding: Drop a single card, a matching set (e.g. 9♠-9♥-9♦), or a suited sequence (e.g. 4♣-5♣-6♣) onto the Discard Pile.
  2. Match & Skip: If your discard matches the rank of the current top discard card, your turn concludes immediately without drawing, permanently shrinking your hand.
  3. Phase 2 – Drawing: If not skipped, draw 1 card from either the face-down Draw Deck or the face-up Discard Pile. If a drawn deck card matches your discard rank, it drops immediately to the discard pile without entering hand.

🏆 Calling "LEAST!" & 80-Point Penalty

When your hand sum drops to 10 points or less, you can call LEAST! on your turn before discarding. All hands are revealed: if your hand is strictly lower than every opponent, you win the round with 0 penalty points. Opponents receive points equal to their hand score minus your winning score. However, if any opponent ties or holds a lower score, you incur an 80-point penalty, while the true lowest player wins with 0 points. Players reaching 200 cumulative points across rounds are eliminated.
